text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! We will be holding a 
mixed-grade recreational event at a 
facility in the suburbs! Please use this 
opportunity to deepen your bonds!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like all our members are here! Once 
again, great to be working with you both!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Um... I-I'll do my best not to 
hold everyone back...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? With the three 
of us, we can definitely aim for the Best 
Team award!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just as I predicted♪ If the path is rough, 
fewer girls will take it, making it the 
perfect shortcut!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, I'll take the lead and check for 
safety. You two follow me once I give the 
signal!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I'll go next... Crown-san, so you 
won't be in danger... I-I'll guide you...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Dinner is done, so all that's 
left is our strategy meeting for 
tomorrow's beach volleyball tournament!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, I'll go wash the dishes! You 
two go ahead and brainstorm the strategy!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Please wait, we'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I would've been fine on my own. Sorry 
for troubling you."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
No. If we all work on it together, it'll 
be done faster, and the three of us will 
have more time to brainstorm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly♪ Let's wrap this up quick 
and go buy some snacks, okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Sweets? Not a strategy meeting...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your brain works better when you take 
in sugar. Let's make it a sweets party and 
have fun doing it! Right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yeah. I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that settles our strategy! 
Though... there's just one thing bugging 
me.

While patrolling to help with the 
recreational activities, I spotted Cheval 
Grand's group.
choice_data_list:
...What's wrong? Are you all lost in 
thought?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Umm... it's not so much thinking, but we 
were just talking about how this 
recreation might be "a bit too easy"...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
For example... Shion-san always takes the 
lead and guides us, plus...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Miss Crown is a total mood-maker— she 
always keeps things bright and lively.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever there's something we overlook, 
Cheval covers for us completely. And 
strangely enough, it just fits so 
naturally."
choice_data_list: It's like we're in sync or something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Synchro, or rather... "connecting 
seamlessly"? Like everything clicks into 
its rightful place right from the start—
choice_data_list: ...It just kinda crossed my mind, but...

text_block_list.text:
"Hearing their story, their dynamics felt 
reminiscent of an eldest, middle, and 
youngest sister, so I share that 
impression with them."
choice_data_list:
Isn't that actually working out well for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ooh... I see! That might be it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So their coordination is based on the 
three sisters' positioning... Heheh. Now 
that I've figured out the trick, our 
chances of winning tomorrow's beach 
volleyball tournament just went way up!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, all matches have 
concluded! The champions are this squad, 
who showed astonishing teamwork!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally♪ With Shion-san's lead and 
Cheval's support, no team can beat us!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's not true... Wasn't it Crown-san who 
racked up all those points with her 
amazing attacks...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, putting aside Shion-san who led 
the game with all her tosses... I was 
really just scrambling for the ball and 
keeping the rally alive—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why! You read our moves and 
supported us so well—that's how we seized 
victory. You're the MVP here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Cheval is our goddess of 
victory♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-Both of you...!? C-Come onnn... please, 
cut it out already...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uuu... I'm finally free...
choice_data_list: The Goddess of Victory, you say?

That was a victory thanks to the three of 
you working together!

That was a victory thanks to the three of 
you working together, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uuu... I'm finally free...
choice_data_list: The Goddess of Victory, you say?

That was a victory thanks to the three of 
you working together!

That was a victory thanks to the three of 
you working together, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Not you too, Trainer... Uuu~. Please stop 
teasing meee...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm not teasing you! It was only because 
you were there that I was able to push 
forward so aggressively.
choice_data_list:
When there's something to be proud of, we 
should be proud with all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Yes. You're right... I-I... I did 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But... there were times when I made 
mistakes and held everyone back.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That goes both ways! If you hadn't 
covered for our mistakes so well, 
Cheval-san, we would've been in serious 
trouble."
choice_data_list:
See, you're making a solid contribution, 
aren't you?
See, you're making a solid contribution!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-If that's the case... I'm glad. So I... 
really was able to help out.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No! Someone like me is nowhere near...!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-saaan! You left something behind in 
the interview booth~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Sorry, I'm coming right now—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you okay? You'll trip if you 
rush too much!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a bunch! I'll come pick it up 
later!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm so glad I got to be in a group 
with the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I feel you. It's sad that recreation time 
ends today, though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"We can just make another chance! Let's do 
something together as the three of us 
again♪ Right!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yeah...!
